summary: Comprehensive testing of Vehicle HMI for 1989 Honda Accord completed successfully. All visual updates, Android Auto positioning, DHU integration, and UI elements are working correctly.

Android Auto panel positioned higher (not blocking warning lights)
x1000 RPM image appears below RPM digital readout
Turn signals use clean arrow SVG design (not emoji)
Red background gradually transitions from 86-120 mph (verified at 118 MPH)
Warning lights visible at bottom when Android Auto is open
DHU status API endpoint works (/api/dhu/status)
DHU start API endpoint exists (/api/dhu/start)
DHU stop API endpoint exists (/api/dhu/stop)
Orbitron font applied to speed, gear, RPM displays
Settings modal opens and closes properly
Theme selection functionality works
Real-time vehicle data updates
Responsive design on tablet and mobile
All backend APIs return correct responses
Vehicle data simulation working correctly
Android Auto mock UI displays navigation interface
Shift lights activate at high RPM
Warning panel shows service indicators
Turn signal SVG animations work properly
